conclusion_zh: 当前 tracked 公开 driver 和已验 R107 有限接口都没有 peer-active 时完整包 CPU 消费/归还合同；真实硬件已有精确 span、逐 lane 完成和并发 DMA，WT whole-cache fence.i 本身不要求所有 DMA quiet，不能裁决平台不可能。应明确增加有界 packet ownership/cache glue 后才能称此路径可达；本轮没有实现或验证该新增合同。

independent_verdicts.question: 精确地址/长度与逐DMA完成原语是否存在
independent_verdicts.scope: 静态硬件/driver内部原语：非batch DEFAULT四span，正NEXT/精确DONE、per-lane STATUS、并发poll/refill。不是已部署packet API。

independent_verdicts.question: 现有公开Linux接口是否已经支持完整包CPU交接、消费和B归还且peer仍active
independent_verdicts.scope: 缺packet/span/cookie/length输入、完整packet join、payload所有权及per-packet CPU acquire/publish/consume/release。现有driver已可双DMA并发，缺项不能表述为硬件强制全局串行。

independent_verdicts.question: 已验R107或旧globalquiet有限投影是否证明原生逐包重叠
independent_verdicts.scope: R107 source snapshot仅证明那一版all-engine-idle有限合同存在和已验范围；globalquiet主动删除native overlap，不能作native逐包性能证据，也不能反证硬件绝无此能力。

independent_verdicts.question: 当前板上是否已验证逐包cache交接或native性能
independent_verdicts.scope: 本轮没有设备探测、构建、实验或部署。最后已验f9/finite-kernel身份是历史记录。

call_chain: readq NEXT side-effect acceptance; retain positive expected ID
reg64 frontend nonbatch COUNT->WAIT holds one job until backend response
AXI R handshakes feed byte buffers; W beats use available bytes and exact WSTRB; final B is paired with last-burst FIFO
backend rsp_valid for DEFAULT = w_dp_rsp_valid & w_last_burst
frontend retires ID into DONE; STATUS reflects OR of backend busy bits
driver readq DONE matches expected ID; existing CPU verification is delayed until both participating streams drain
hardware_completion.completion_limit: 正常AXI copy的数据因果链包含R->buffer->W->末B，不是仅AW/W发出。包交接仍需全部span完成、受控单issuer/无该包未来工作以及所需lane/stock关闭；STATUS单独不等于通用frontend/FIFO/跨owner drain。
hardware_completion.error_handling_config: Explicit NO_ERROR_HANDLING; backend response error tied zero
hardware_completion.existing_fault_evidence: IOMMU FQ记录cause/DID/iotval，但driver只限频打印；page request回调是另一路，未绑定iDMA transfer-ID/packet。observer sticky error记录ID/握手守恒，不包含每次RRESP/BRESP输入。timeout/unknown NEXT有quarantine。
hardware_completion.bounded_success_path: 受控模型/有限适配可以保留完整实际字节与guard验证；这不是零成本生产错误状态，也不要求先实现完整生产错误恢复才研究成功路径。
failure_options: 限定受控成功路径并在CPU安全获得包后做完整字节核验，明确额外读取/保留源及校验成本
若要生产异常安全成功回执，另行定义现有fault收集/transfer与packet关联、RRESP/BRESP覆盖和超时隔离能力；是否需要新增RTL尚未裁决

actual_f9_config_chain: ariane_pkg.sv:495 uses this config; cva6.sv:747 selects WT subsystem
cache_and_ordering.cache_operation: local_flush_icache_all -> asm fence.i memory clobber -> commit waits CPU store/writebuffer -> controller Icache+Dcache flush -> WT missunit drains CPU MSHR/writebuffer, clears all Dcache valid bits, ack
cache_and_ordering.reason: Cache flush hardware waits CPU-private work and has no all-DMA-idle input; it invalidates WT cache valid bits, not dirty data-line writeback. Peer disjoint DMA can continue in principle. This alone does not implement a correct packet ownership protocol.
cache_and_ordering.generic_dma_api_limit: Linux DMA sync reaches ALT_CMO; default alternative is nop, with runtime ZICBOM/THead selection. CONFIG=y alone and API names are not proof of supported cache maintenance on this CVA6; tracked DTS advertises rv64imafdch, not ZICBOM. Existing actual driver uses explicit platform fence.i workaround.
cache_and_ordering.mmio_order: readq supplies fence i,r and writeq fence w,o. These order MMIO/memory but do not invalidate stale payload cache. Header/used publication still needs release ordering and correct ownership.

named_adaptation.name: bounded complete-packet CPU handoff while disjoint peer DMA remains active
named_adaptation.scope: 同一个可信owner、原三包与四span、原地址和长度、DID10/11共同context、2MiB驻留映射。新增有限软件packet状态/缓存所有权glue，不重启R107或声称native DPDK已移植。
required_conditions: 精确描述packet、全部span、源/目的buffer和cookie/capacity；packet3必须503+1011两段齐才是1514B完整包
绑定实际WT配置、single-hart和CPU PA/IOVA alias；源/目的与metadata有明确所有权，禁止其他issuer/rebind或未知访问
启动前把header/源/目的初始化全部写完，排空CPU写buffer并完成本平台cache交接；header与payload共享行内不留未排空CPU写
DMA持有的payload/整cacheline闭包不可由CPU或别的owner访问；CPU仅访问已完成packet的整行闭包及独立metadata。禁止peer-active时全16KiB池/全guard扫描
每个span positive NEXT与expected DONE对应；所有相关span结束，且该packet不再有未完成/未来R/W/B访问。先据已有primitive形成受控lane-drain证明，不能将一个STATUS读冒充通用证明
完整packet交接前执行whole-cache fence.i并确保返回后的payload可见性，然后有序publish used、从原B cookie/address消费；下一包另作交接，不能复用早先在peer未完成时缓存的payload
A源读退休、A/host staging归还、B used发布和B guest实际消费后的归还分别记录；copy全部完成是保守源读退休边界，host free_pkts不是B消费
buffer逻辑归还不撤销覆盖peer的2MiB resident leaf。最终停止所有相关issuer、checked quiet/barrier后才unmap/free；unknown NEXT/timeout/无法证明关闭时保留且quarantine相关共享allocation
明确成功路径核验或异常状态合同及实际成本；DONE不单独升级成无错误包完成
named_adaptation.sufficiency_boundary: 在正常、无AXI错误且完整数据/守恒已独立验证的受控执行中，上述条件可构成peer-active逐包消费的安全充分合同。它不是现有实现/验证结果，也不是所有实现都必须采用的唯一必要方法。生产异常安全仍需收束错误关联。
smallest_missing_software_interface: per-packet cache/ownership acquire and used publication
B consumer completion/recycle distinct from source read retirement
retained resident mapping and bounded uncertain-state quarantine
costs_to_include: CPU per-span issue and per-packet poll
whole I/D cache invalidation and resulting refills
actual consumer work and source hold extension
